该协议的核心目标是将能够创造更高就业水平并为最脆弱群体提供基本社会保障的措施置于复苏努力的中心
这些新规定是作为抗肥胖运动的一部分推出的
从上周六开始,规模足够大而受该规定约束的连锁店如果不在菜单的显著位置(最好在价格旁边)显示卡路里信息
M: 是的，我明白你的意思
W: 是的，没错。你话不多
M: 那你用大拇指打字快吗？
W: 嗯，我刚拿到手机的时候特别慢
M: 实际上我的问题正相反
W: 是啊，我觉得发短信其实跟年龄有关

items.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

choices.text: The International Labour Organization's key objective.
choices.zh: 国际劳工组织的关键目标。

choices.text: The basic social protection for the most vulnerable.
choices.zh: 为最脆弱群体提供的基本社会保护。

choices.text: Rising unemployment worldwide.
choices.zh: 全球范围内不断上升的失业率。

choices.text: Global economic recovery.

items.stem: What does Juan Somavia, Director-General of the International Labour Organization say?

choices.text: Many countries have not taken measures to create enough jobs.
choices.zh: 许多国家没有采取措施创造足够的就业机会。

choices.text: Few countries know how to address the current economic crisis.
choices.zh: 很少有国家知道如何应对当前的经济危机。

choices.text: Few countries have realized the seriousness of the current crisis.
choices.zh: 很少有国家意识到当前危机的严重性。

choices.text: Many countries need support to improve their people's livelihood.
choices.zh: 许多国家需要支持以改善其人民的生计。

items.stem: What are big fast food chains in New York City required to do according to the new rule?

choices.text: Serve standardized food nationwide.
choices.zh: 在全国范围内提供标准化食品。

choices.text: Put calorie information on the menu.
choices.zh: 在菜单上标注卡路里信息。

choices.text: Increase protein content in the food.
choices.zh: 增加食品中的蛋白质含量。

choices.text: Offer convenient food to customers.
choices.zh: 为顾客提供便捷的食品。

items.stem: What will happen to big restaurant chains that violate the new rule?

choices.text: They will be fined.
They will be closed.
They will get a warning.
They will lose customers.

items.stem: What is the problem with many companies according to the news report?

choices.text: Inability to implement their business plans.
Inability to keep turning out novel products.
choices.zh: 无法持续推出新颖的产品。

choices.text: Lack of a successful business model of their own.
choices.zh: 缺乏自己的成功商业模式。

choices.text: Failure to integrate innovation into their business.
choices.zh: 未能将创新融入其业务。

items.stem: What do many people tend to think of innovation?

choices.text: It is the secret to business success.
It is the creation of something new.
It is a magic tool to bring big rewards.
choices.zh: 它是带来丰厚回报的神奇工具。

choices.text: It is an essential part of business culture.
choices.zh: 它是企业文化的重要组成部分。

items.stem: What does the company Procter&Gamble owe its success to?

choices.text: Its hardworking employees.
Its flexible promotion strategy.
Its innovation culture.
Its willingness to make investments.

items.stem: What does the man say about himself?

choices.text: He's got addicted to technology.
He is not very good at socializing
He is crazy about text-messaging.
He does not talk long on the phone.

items.stem: What does the woman tend to do while she is on the phone?

choices.text: Talk big.
Talk at length.
Gossip a lot.
Forget herself.

items.stem: Why did the man text message all his friends when he first got his cell phone?

choices.text: He thought it was cool.
He needed the practice.
He wanted to stay connected with them.
He had an urgent message to send.

items.stem: What does the woman's father think of text-messaging?

choices.text: It poses a challenge to seniors.
It saves both time and money.
It is childish and unprofessional.
It is cool and convenient.

items.stem: What do we learn about the man from the conversation?

choices.text: He wants to change his job assignment.
choices.zh: 他想要改变自己的工作安排。

choices.text: He is unhappy with his department manager
choices.zh: 他对自己的部门经理不满意。

choices.text: He thinks he deserves extra pay for overtime.
choices.zh: 他认为自己应该得到加班费。

choices.text: He is often singled out for criticism by his boss
choices.zh: 他经常被老板单独挑出来批评。

items.stem: What is the man's chief complaint?

choices.text: His workload was much too heavy.
His immediate boss did not trust him
choices.zh: 他的直接上司不信任他。

choices.text: His colleagues often refused to cooperate.
choices.zh: 他的同事经常拒绝合作。

choices.text: His salary was too low for his responsibility
choices.zh: 相对于他的职责,他的薪水太低了。

items.stem: How does the woman interpret the fact that the man was asked to help his colleagues with their work?

choices.text: He never knows how to refuse.
He is always ready to help others
His boss has a lot of trust in him.
His boss has no sense of fairness.

items.stem: What did the woman advise the man to do?

choices.text: Put all his complaints in writing.
choices.zh: 把他所有的抱怨都写下来。

choices.text: Wait and see what happens next.
choices.zh: 等着看接下来会发生什么。

choices.text: Learn to say no when necessary.
Talk to his boss in person first.
choices.zh: 先亲自和他的老板谈谈。

items.stem: What is the speaker mainly talking about?

choices.text: The importance of sleep to a healthy life.
choices.zh: 睡眠对健康生活的重要性。

choices.text: Reasons for Americans' decline in sleep.
choices.zh: 美国人睡眠减少的原因。

choices.text: Some tips to improve the quality of sleep.
choices.zh: 一些改善睡眠质量的建议。

choices.text: Diseases associated with lack of sleep.
choices.zh: 与缺乏睡眠相关的疾病。

items.stem: What do we learn from the talk about today's Americans?

choices.text: They are more health-conscious.
They are changing their living habits.
choices.zh: 他们正在改变生活习惯。

choices.text: They get less and less sleep.
They know the dangers of lack of sleep.
choices.zh: 他们知道缺乏睡眠的危害。

items.stem: What does the speaker say will happen to people who lack sleep?

choices.text: Their weight will go down.
Their mind function will deteriorate.
choices.zh: 他们的大脑功能会退化。

choices.text: Their work efficiency will decrease.
choices.zh: 他们的工作效率会降低。

choices.text: Their blood pressure will rise.

items.stem: What is the first decision you should make in preparing to apply for a place at university?

choices.text: How much you can afford to pay.
What course you are going to choose.
Which university you are going to apply to.
When you are going to submit your application.
choices.zh: 你将要在什么时候提交申请。

items.stem: What is the most important part of the application?

choices.text: The list of courses studied.
The full record of scores.
The references from teachers.
The personal statement.

items.stem: What must applicants do in their personal statements?

choices.text: Specify what they would like to do after graduation.
choices.zh: 明确说明他们毕业后想做什么。

choices.text: Describe in detail how much they would enjoy studying.
choices.zh: 详细描述他们会多么享受学习。

choices.text: Indicate they have reflected and thought about the subject.
choices.zh: 表明他们已经对该学科进行了反思和思考。

choices.text: Emphasize that they admire the professors in the university.
choices.zh: 强调他们钦佩该大学的教授。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the first motor car?

choices.text: It was equipped with rubber tyres.
It was built in the late 19th century.
It was purchased by the Royal family.
It was designed by an English engineer.
choices.zh: 它由一位英国工程师设计。

items.stem: What was the problem with the early cars in Britain?

choices.text: They consumed lots of petrol.
They took two passengers only.
choices.zh: 它们只能搭载两名乘客。

choices.text: They were difficult to drive.
They often broke down.

items.stem: Why did Henry Ford's Model T cars cost less?

choices.text: They were produced on the assembly line.
They were built with less costly materials.
choices.zh: 它们用更便宜的材料建造。

choices.text: They were modeled after British cars.
choices.zh: 它们以英国汽车为原型。

choices.text: They were made for ordinary use.
choices.zh: 它们为日常使用而制造。

items.stem: What do we learn about the Preston Bypass?

choices.text: It made news all over the world.
It was built for the Royal family.
It marked a new era in motor travel.
choices.zh: 它标志着汽车旅行的新时代。

choices.text: It attracted large numbers of motorists.
